svg.title: The wh badge and band in Claude Code while a run goes
svg.desc: Claude Code runs wh in bash mode. The band above the prompt names the run and its time; the footer badge's arrows swap during the copy, then it spins while the job runs, and both go when it ends. Each state lasts 2.5 seconds.
